title: The claimed W3'' fix is defective: the 'alignment-sensitive' header pin asserts only noc_class_columns constants — reverting the header draws to left-aligned draw_mono_c (the r2 B1' blocker) still stays green
evidence: noc_overlay_test.odin:365-368 — `testing.expect(t, pitch >= hdr4, "the 15px headers fit the 84px pitch when right-aligned")` / `gap := f32(sla_x - loss_r)` / `testing.expect(t, gap < hdr4, "the loss->SLA gap is narrower than the loss header - ONLY right-alignment fits (left-aligned headers collide)")` / `testing.expect(t, f32(rate_r) <= f32(1280) - 6, ...)`. noc_overlay.odin:702-706 — `noc_col(v, "del", NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL, del_r, y)` / `noc_col(v, "drop", ...)` / `noc_col(v, "loss", ...)` / `draw_mono_c(v, "SLA", sla_x, ...)` / `noc_col(v, "/3s", ...)`. grep noc_col across app/render/*test* and app/: no matches outside noc_overlay.odin; grep draw_noc_panel/draw_noc_overlay in *_test*: no matches.
detail: Every new assertion is a pure function of noc_class_columns + font metrics; none references the header draw calls. Replacing the five header noc_col calls with left-aligned draw_mono_c(v, "loss", loss_r, ...) keeps every test green — exactly the regression W3'' named.
recommended_fix: Pin the alignment itself: extract the header-row x positions (noc_col contract: x = anchor − measured width) into a helper the draw calls and the test asserts, or assert via a noc_col-exercising draw-level test.

title: The claimed N1' cleanup is defective: the duplicate DOCK-RIGHT sentence still ships twice, back-to-back, in overlay_check — both copies added by this fix commit
evidence: harness/overlay.odin:72-77 — `// DOCK-RIGHT (fit-to-rail): the capture renders the app's D-on playfield` / `// (play_w = win_w - NOC_RAIL_W) so the frame matches the real run.` / `feed: rnd.Noc_Feed` / `rnd.noc_feed_scan(&feed, state.events[:])` / `// DOCK-RIGHT (fit-to-rail): the capture renders the app's D-on playfield` / `// (play_w = win_w - NOC_RAIL_W) so the frame matches the real run — and`. The diff.patch hunk shows both comment blocks as '+' additions.
detail: The PR body claims "r2-N1' ... comment staleness cleaned", but the same two-line sentence now appears twice around the feed declaration — the exact duplication N1' flagged, re-introduced by this commit's own edit.
recommended_fix: Delete the first two-line copy (keep the second, which carries the view_refit rationale), or merge into one comment above the feed scan.

title: The claimed 'large numerals' staleness cleanup is partial: the header block still advertises 'large numerals ... the drop-reason counters are the headline row' (counters are now the 18px body rung; title is 20px)
evidence: app/render/noc_overlay.odin:21-22 — `// equal advances, verified); (2) hierarchy: small-caps labels, large numerals,` / `// the drop-reason counters are the headline row; (3) a dark semi-opaque`. The r3 N3'' flagged :21,:640; this commit cleaned only :647 (`// --- DROPS headline (the headline row: the counters + their labels) ---`) and left :21-22 untouched.
detail: The briefing says this fix claims the stale 'large numerals' comments cleaned; one of the two flagged spots persists. The commit edited the adjacent line (Open Sans → Plex Mono) but left the stale hierarchy claim.
recommended_fix: Update item (2) to the ladder wording, e.g. 'hierarchy: 15px small-caps labels, 18px counters, 20px title' — matching the cleaned DROPS comment.

title: PR-body claim 'noc_class_columns — the draw, the W7 pin and the smoke read it' is false: the overlay-pixels smoke never references noc_class_columns
evidence: harness/overlay.odin:257 — `rect := rnd.noc_panel_rect(rc.view.win_w, rc.view.win_h)` (the smoke's only geometry read). grep 'noc_class_columns' across app/ harness/ core/ returns exactly two files: app/render/noc_overlay.odin:692 (the draw) and app/render/noc_overlay_test.odin:347 (the pin) — no harness hit.
detail: The single-source claim overstates its readers: the smoke counts pixels inside noc_panel_rect only and has no coupling to the column anchors. Comment at noc_overlay.odin:690 ('the header + the data rows + the pins') is the accurate version.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR-body sentence to 'the draw and the W7 pin read it' (or add the smoke as a real reader if column-pixel checks are wanted).
